SYC.note: The framework sets school guidance and tool lists for education only; no rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
The document concerns AI in education, a sector, not general administration.

facts.fact: The Seychelles Ministry of Education says it is already advancing education initiatives that incorporate AI, including Smart Classroom, Teacher Coach and Student Tutor, to be scaled under its 2026-2030 AI in Education Framework.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Human Resource Development

SYC.note: The document names no AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country.
